title: bupleurum ranunculoides var. telonense
intro: Bupleurum ranunculoides var. telonense, commonly known as Telon's Bupleurum, is a variety of the Bupleurum ranunculoides plant, which belongs to the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and improving liver function. The therapeutic actions of Telon's Bupleurum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, and act as a hepatoprotective agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
